The streaming server will support a maximum of 700 movies; new servers can be added to support more movies.
The system shall provide multi language support.

The website will use standard Internet conventions when interacting with the user.
The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.

Customers must have a valid login id to enter into the site.

All movies shall be streamed on demand  at any time of the day.
Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek are the only people who shall have access to students\92 personal information.
The System shall granularly control access rights to all major subsystems.  It should be possible to assign access rights to all subsystems independently.

The logo and the current basic design of registration system should be displayed. The system should be attractive according to the clients. The design and the color should make users feel comfortable when using the system instead of flashing useless colors on the screen. The design should also reflect the seriousness of the environment.
Only collision estimators shall search for recycled parts.  Users without the collision estimator role shall not have access to the search for recycled parts.

Movies shall be encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.
All business rules specified in the Disputes System shall be in compliance to the guidelines of Regulation E and Regulation Z.
The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.
The website will comply with W3C standards.

The product must make use of web/application server technology.  Open source examples include Apache web server  Tomcat  and the JBoss application server.
The system should use the company colors and logos.
Users shall be required to log into the system for all operations except the operations on the login page.
Aside from server failure  the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.
All Web pages generated by the system shall be fully downloadable in no more than 10 seconds over a 40KBps modem connection.
The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.
The website shall not be offensive to religious or ethnic groups.
The message board shall contain the 5 most recently posted messages on the league page. The messages will contain up to the first 150 characters of the message.
The system shall not leave any cookies on the customer’s computer containing the user’s password.
All login attempts shall be done so in a secure manner.
The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.
The application shall have a downtime of at most 10 minutes per year.
The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.
Responses to view information shall take no longer than 5 seconds to appear on the screen.
A correct combination of username and password is required for a user to login.
The product shall be updated on a regular basis.The product will have a new major feature introduced every six months and quarterly maintenance releases every six months.

The reliability of the overall program depends on the reliability of the separate components. The main pillar of reliability of the system is the backup of the database which is continuously maintained and updated to reflect the most recent changes.
The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy  accessible on all pages of the website.
The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.
The system will fully function in major browsers.
The interface shall be easy to use. 90% of users should be able to successfully use the system to generate a report on their first use. The interface should adhere to IBM usability standards.
System shall let administrator de-activate a customer account in under 1 minute. Customer will no longer be able to access the website.
The menus of the system must be easily navigable by the users with buttons that are easy to understand.
The product shall free of computer viruses.
100% of the cardmember and merchant services representatives shall use the Disputes application regularly after a 2-day training course.
A new user shall be able to navigate through the league and team pages within 30 seconds of reaching the start-up page.
The product shall information Security. The product shall enable privacy by encryption WS-Security and Integrity Checking.
Only valid data shall be entered into the system. No invalid data shall be entered into the system.
The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.
The product shall increase productivity of Collision Estimators. 80% of the Collision Estimators shall agree their productivity has increase within 1 month of using the product.
The product must support Mozilla Firefox 1.0 and above.

The system shall interface with CampusConnect\92s central server

The System shall allow for a minimum of  6 users to work at the same time.

The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.
The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.
It should not take more than 90 seconds for a registered user to place an order.
